  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

The rear parking camera assists with reversing and parking maneuvers, while the low tire pressure warning system helps you maintain proper inflation.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this Mercedes-Benz A-Class in person. Our team looks forward to answering your questions and helping you take the next step toward ownership.

HomeLink garage door transmitter integration offers seamless home automation, while the trip computer and tachometer give you detailed driving information at a glance.

With a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine producing 149 horsepower at 6400 rpm and 146 lb-ft of torque at 4400 rpm, this gasoline-powered vehicle offers a smooth and responsive drive. Its front-wheel-drive setup ensures confident handling on city streets and highways, with impressive fuel economy—29 mpg in the city and 39 mpg on the highway—making it an economical choice for daily commuting. The Sentra SV features a spacious four-door design with seating for five, perfect for families or those who need versatile space. This used vehicle comes equipped with modern amenities like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, and satellite radio readiness, enhancing connectivity and entertainment on every trip. Safety features such as adaptive cruise control, a backup camera, blind spot monitor, collision warning, and cross traffic alert deliver peace of mind, while keyless entry and push-to-start simplify daily use. Designed with convenience and safety at the forefront, the 2021 Nissan Sentra SV provides a suite of features that elevate everyday driveability. Adaptive cruise control helps maintain a safe following distance, and the backup camera offers clear rear visibility, making parking easier. The blind spot monitor and collision warning systems add layers of protection, alerting drivers to potential hazards. Inside, keyless entry and push start provide effortless access and ignition, complemented by Bluetooth connectivity for hands-free calling and audio streaming. The vehicle’s infotainment system features an 8-inch touchscreen display that supports real-time traffic updates and a touch interface for easy operation. Six speakers deliver quality sound, and auxiliary inputs for USB and iPod/iPhone ensure your favorite music is always within reach. With these features, the Sentra SV offers a blend of modern technology and practical design for a satisfying driving experience. 2021 Nissan Sentra Safety and Security Features The safety and security of this vehicle are backed by a comprehensive set of features. Automatic emergency braking at the rear helps prevent collisions, while a check rear seat reminder encourages safe passenger awareness. Dual front knee airbags provide additional protection in a crash, and rear parking sensors assist with precise maneuvering. The vehicle’s four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) enhances stopping power and stability, especially on slippery surfaces. Power door locks with anti-lockout prevent locking yourself out, and cornering brake control offers improved handling during turns. Auto-locking power door locks ensure added security when driving, making this Sentra a reliable choice for everyday safety. 2021 Nissan Sentra Entertainment and Technology Features This used Nissan Sentra SV is packed with entertainment and tech features designed to keep drivers connected and entertained. Voice-operated hands-free phone call integration allows seamless communication without distraction. The infotainment system’s radio is also voice-controlled, and the 8-inch touchscreen display offers an intuitive interface for media and settings. Real-time traffic data helps you navigate efficiently, while electronic messaging assistance with a read function and voice operation keep you connected safely. The sound system includes six speakers for clear audio, and auxiliary inputs for USB and iPod/iPhone enable you to enjoy your favorite tunes effortlessly. Whether commuting or cruising, these features create a connected, enjoyable driving experience.

It features traffic sign recognition with adaptive speed limiting, dual front knee airbags, and a comprehensive camera system covering front, rear, and sides. Parking sensors at the front and rear assist in tight spaces, complemented by regenerative braking that enhances efficiency. The dash cameras provide front, rear, and side recording, adding an extra layer of security. Four-wheel ABS ensures stable stopping power in all conditions, making this Model 3 a dependable choice for daily driving and long trips alike. Its suite of safety features reflects Tesla’s commitment to protecting its occupants while offering peace of mind. 2021 Tesla Model 3 Safety and Security Features The safety suite includes traffic sign recognition with adaptive speed limiting, dual front knee airbags, and a detailed camera system covering front, rear, and sides. Parking sensors at the front and rear assist with maneuvering tight spots, while regenerative braking improves efficiency and reduces brake wear. Dash cameras record front, rear, and side views, providing security footage in case of incidents. Four-wheel ABS enhances braking stability, ensuring safe stops under various conditions. These features collectively make the Model 3 a secure, tech-forward choice for drivers prioritizing safety. 2021 Tesla Model 3 Entertainment and Technology Features The Tesla Model 3 Long Range is equipped with a 15-inch infotainment touchscreen that serves as the control hub for media, navigation, and vehicle settings. Smartphone integration allows you to use your phone as a key and remotely start the engine or precondition the cabin via the Tesla App. The sound system includes 14 speakers delivering 560 watts of audio power for immersive listening. Wi-Fi hotspot capability keeps you connected on the go, and voice-activated commands handle phone calls, radio, and other functions seamlessly. This combination of entertainment and tech features offers a connected, enjoyable driving experience for tech-savvy drivers. 2021 Tesla Model 3 Performance Features This used Model 3 Long Range boasts an electric motor capable of 353 miles per charge, thanks to its lithium-ion battery pack. Charging is straightforward, with a 10-hour recharge time on 240V power. Its full-time AWD system ensures optimal traction and stability in all conditions, whether accelerating on wet roads or navigating uneven terrain. The electric drivetrain’s efficiency and power make this Tesla a compelling option for drivers seeking impressive range and performance in a stylish, practical sedan.

This used electric vehicle combines sleek style with impressive performance, offering a smooth and quiet ride thanks to its AWD drivetrain and 346 horsepower. The black interior provides a sophisticated contrast to the vibrant exterior, accommodating five passengers comfortably. Equipped with advanced features like adaptive cruise control, a backup camera, blind spot monitor, and collision warning, this Model 3 prioritizes safety and convenience. Enjoy modern comforts such as heated seats, a sunroof/moonroof, keyless entry, memory seats, and rear heated seats, along with wireless phone charging. Parking sensors at the front and rear, along with regenerative braking, help with maneuvering and energy efficiency. Multiple dash cameras—front, rear, and side—provide added security, while ABS on all four wheels ensures optimal braking performance under various conditions. These features combine to make this vehicle a smart, safe choice for daily commuting and long drives alike. 2021 Tesla Model 3 Safety and Security Features This Model 3 is equipped with traffic sign recognition that helps monitor speed limits and traffic signs, adjusting the vehicle’s speed accordingly. Dual front knee airbags and front camera systems enhance occupant safety. Parking sensors in front and rear assist with tight spots, complemented by regenerative braking that improves efficiency and stopping power. Dash cameras record from three angles, providing security footage if needed. The vehicle also features four-wheel ABS, ensuring reliable braking in all conditions, making safety a top priority. 2021 Tesla Model 3 Entertainment and Technology Features The Model 3’s centerpiece is a 15-inch infotainment screen that offers seamless access to navigation, media, and vehicle controls. It supports smart device app functions like using your phone as a key, engine start, and cabin preconditioning, all through the Tesla App. The audio system delivers crystal-clear sound with 14 speakers and a power output of 560 watts. Hands-free calls and voice-operated radio work effortlessly, while the vehicle's Wi-Fi hotspot keeps you connected on the go. This combination of technology and entertainment makes every drive engaging and convenient. 2021 Tesla Model 3 Performance Features The Model 3 Long Range delivers impressive performance with an electric motor capable of 353 miles per charge, thanks to a lithium-ion battery. Charging is straightforward, taking approximately 10 hours on a 240V outlet. Its full-time AWD system provides consistent power delivery, ensuring strong acceleration and stable handling in all driving conditions. The vehicle's electric powertrain not only offers remarkable range but also delivers quick, responsive performance that makes every trip enjoyable.

This 2021 Tesla Model 3 Long Range represents a significant step forward in electric vehicle technology, combining sophisticated engineering with practical everyday utility for the modern driver.

- Acceleration Boost
- Full Self-Driving Capability
- Full Self-Driving Computer 3
- Autopilot
- Premium Audio System
- Active Cruise Control

- Heated steering wheel

The electric powertrain delivers impressive efficiency ratings of 141 MPGe city and 127 MPGe highway, meaning you'll enjoy extended range between charging sessions while minimizing your energy costs. The all-wheel drive system provides confident traction and stability in various driving conditions, while the single-speed automatic transmission delivers smooth, responsive acceleration whenever you need it.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin designed for comfort and convenience. Premium heated bucket seats in front keep you comfortable during cold months, while the heated rear seats extend that comfort to your passengers. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of warmth during winter drives. The split folding rear seat offers flexibility for cargo while maintaining passenger capacity, and the premium audio system with 15 speakers ensures your music, podcasts, and calls sound crisp and clear.

Advanced driver assistance features are integrated throughout this vehicle. Autopilot combined with Full Self-Driving Capability and the Full Self-Driving Computer 3 provide sophisticated autonomous driving features when you choose to use them. The active cruise control, lane departure warning system, and fully automatic headlights work together to reduce fatigue during longer drives. The exterior parking camera rear assists with maneuvering in tight spaces, and the navigation system keeps you on course.

Climate control is thoughtfully managed with automatic temperature settings, dual-zone front air conditioning, and rear window defrosting. The telescoping and tilting steering wheel adjusts to your preference, while memory seat settings mean your driving position is instantly restored each time you get in. The 18-inch aero wheels complement the striking red exterior while optimizing efficiency.

Safety is addressed through a comprehensive suite of systems including dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering all contribute to responsive handling and accident prevention. The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power.

This 2021 Model 3 Long Range is ready to deliver everything you expect from a premium electric vehicle. We invite you to schedule a time to experience it firsthand and discover why Tesla owners consistently report high satisfaction with their vehicles.

This Glacier Silver Metallic 2018 BMW 3 Series 328d with 58,821 miles would be a welcomed addition to your family/business. Comfort
  • This upholstery simulates leather, is durable and easy to keep clean.
  • Power reclining driver seat - Lean back. Gain some space between you and the wheel with power reclining driver seat. It lets you adjust the angle of the seatback at the touch of a button for added comfort while you're driving, or for a more comfortable rest while you're pulled over. Settle in, with power reclining driver seat.
Convenience
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

The WRX Premium rides on 18-inch alloy wheels and carries performance-oriented brakes, along with sport front seats and a leather-wrapped steering wheel.
